text:
zoe: Alert from KMS audit: partner-sync@thirdparty was granted roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/secure/cryptoKeys/secret-main at 2026-06-12T19:02Z. looks unexpected.
michael: paste admin audit snippet:
```
{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy","principalEmail":"partner-sync@thirdparty","resourceName":"projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/secret-main","timestamp":"2026-06-12T19:02:01Z"}}
```
zoe: that key backs Vault transit mount and some backup buckets. rotor-bot flagged anomaly.
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly score high. recommended: snapshot policy, export 30d audit, create ephemeral ops SA for rewrap, revoke partner binding, rewrap ciphertexts, rotate tokens.
tara: containment plan: staged revoke. create ops-sa, grant rewrap rights, revoke partner binding, run canary rewrap, smoke test, then rotate secrets.
sec-oncall: agree. running quick asset search to enumerate dependents:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:secret-main" --format=json
```
michael: results: vault-transit-secrets, backups-2025, analytics-export, ingest-fn.
vendor-sec: pinged vendor for logs. they claim a config sync ran but show no SetIamPolicy in their logs; asking for proof.
zoe: created ephemeral ops-sa and granted limited KMS permissions at 4532110200. revoking partner binding at 4532110300.
michael: revoke complete. running canary rewrap on analytics-export:
```
./tools/rewrap --src secret-main --dst secret-main-rot-20260612 --resources ./canary.json --parallel 4
```
sec-oncall: canary passed smoke checks for ingest-fn and Vault transit. one backup job retried and recovered.
vendor-sec: vendor provided evidence of an unconditioned IAM change from their automation; we'll require terraform-locked IAM and conditions in onboarding checklist.
zoe: uploaded audit export for forensics: https://logs.internal/exports/secret-main-453210.json :lock:
rotor-bot: [automated] incident INC-2026-211 created and KMS audit retention increased to 90 days for prod.
tara: next actions: finish full rewrap, rotate DB creds and Vault transit keys, add alert rule for cross-project KMS grants, update vendor onboarding docs. will write a short blameless postmortem. thanks all :thumbsup:
